description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for cloning a repository, handling large files with a mock Git LFS system, and validating correct behavior for file storage, deletion, and synchronization based on file size and extension. It also tests interactions with a Perforce depot through the 'p4' command, including setting configurations for large file handling.

methods.name: test_file_is_not_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Checks that a specified file with given content is correctly stored and matches expectations, verifying it is not managed by the mock LFS system.

methods.name: test_file_is_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that specified files are stored as pointers and content in the mock storage, indicating LFS handling.

methods.name: test_file_is_deleted_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Confirms that a file has been deleted in the working directory but remains present in local and remote mock storage.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Counts files in a directory and compares the count to an expected value.
